text.paragraph: OCREVUS is indicated for the treatment of:

list.item: Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS), to include clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, in adults

item.content: Relapsing-remitting MS, in pediatric patients 10 years of age and older who weigh 25 kg or more.

text.paragraph: OCREVUS is a CD20-directed cytolytic antibody indicated for the treatment of:

list.item: Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS), to include clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, in adults (1)
Relapsing-remitting MS, in pediatric patients 10 years of age and older who weigh 25 kg or more (1)
